text.p: -- Interacciones brokerage started coverage of Mexico's Carso Global Telecom with a sell rating.

-- Analyst Robert Hulme said the stock, which is mostly made up of holdings in Mexican telecommunications firm Telefonos de Mexico SA (Telmex), has limited appeal to institutional investors, who would prefer to take advantage of such opportunities in a more direct and efficient manner.

-- Carso Global Telecom (CGT) is trading at a significant premium compared with Telmex's stock. "Likewise we feel the equity of CGT will be restricted by its participation in Telmex, given the uncertainty facing the telecommunications company's long distance markets," Hulme said in a statement.
-- CGT was trading down six centavos at 19.54 pesos at midday on the Mexican stock exchange.
